description: This file defines the ParamRuleCollection class, which manages a collection of parameter validation rules in the OrangeHRM API v2. It provides methods for adding, removing, and retrieving validation rules, as well as managing excluded parameter keys and strict validation mode.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A collection class that manages parameter validation rules, allowing addition, removal, and configuration of validation behaviors for API request parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ParamRuleCollection with optional ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Returns all ParamRule objects in the collection.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Sets multiple ParamRule objects, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a single ParamRule to the collection, throwing an exception if a rule with the same param key already exists.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes a ParamRule by its param key and returns it if found.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether strict validation mode is enabled.

methods.name: setStrict
methods.description: Enables or disables strict validation mode.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of param keys to ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter keys excluded from validation.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of excluded parameter keys.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a single param key to the list of excluded keys.
